rosalie.line: That you'll stay away from Rosalie
stanza: Stick to the promise man, that you made me
Stick to the promise man, that you made me
Stick to the promise man, that you made me
That you'll stay away from Rosalie

rosalie.line: And they rhymed orange with Rosalie
stanza: Shooting dice and playing Rambling Jack's guitar
With the cowboy painting pick guard on it
And they sat in the back and drank for free
And they rhymed orange with Rosalie
Now there's a pride of lions to draw to
